title: 雨夜咖啡馆的时间循环

storyBible.worldAnchor: Neon-lit rainy alley, late-night urban cafe, reflective puddles, dim interior, moody atmosphere, consistent characters and locations across scenes

characters.name: Barista
characters.anchorPrompt: Barista in a neon-lit rainy cafe, wearing a simple apron, neutral expression, slightly trembling hands

props.name: Wind chime bell
props.anchorPrompt: Metal wind chime bell hanging, small, jingling, reflecting light

props.name: Neon sign
props.anchorPrompt: Neon sign with stylized letters, glowing, flickering, reflecting on puddles

props.name: Coffee cup
props.anchorPrompt: Steaming ceramic coffee cup, black mug, small steam curls

props.name: Paper note
props.anchorPrompt: Wet paper note, crumpled, water droplets, handwritten text

locations.name: Cafe interior
locations.anchorPrompt: Dim interior of a rainy cafe, wooden counter, neon glow, reflective puddles on floor

locations.name: Cafe exterior
locations.anchorPrompt: Neon-lit street outside the cafe, puddled street, rain falling, neon sign glowing

eventChain: Protagonist enters the rainy cafe, neon sign glows, wind chime rings.
Barista's hands tremble, a wet paper note appears on the table.
Protagonist asks barista about the time loop, barista smiles, rain stops, electric hum, walls peel.
Protagonist reads paper note warning against coffee, barista offers steaming cup.
Choosing to ask the secret triggers defense, darkness engulfs, wind chime rings, protagonist returns to entrance.
Choosing to read note, protagonist runs to back door, rain stops, dawn breaks, protagonist escapes loop.
